result.description:
We were founded in 2002 and have grown to become one of the largest communication infrastructure companies servicing Australia-wide. We provide cable and telecommunication solutions including project management and design services with our wide range of cable installation equipment. Our team includes experienced industry professionals that are known for providing excellent services for all our clients. We strive to deliver product excellence, respect for humanity and the environment.

We are now seeking a Telecommunication Cable Jointer to join our team. To apply you will need to be passionate about cable and telecommunication projects and our clients. You will need strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities, leadership skills and a Certificate by Competencies in Digital Electronics and Telecommunications. You will also need to have over five years’ experience as a Telecommunication Cable Jointer.  We are offering $80K – $90K
Key Responsibilities:
•	Install and Joint Cables
•	Cable Testing and Fault Finding
•	Network Maintenance
•	Excavation and Site Work
•	Documentation and Reporting
•	Health, Safety, and Compliance
•	Customer and Team Coordination
Key Skills Required
•	Fibre optic and copper cable jointing
•	Cable testing and troubleshooting
•	Reading technical plans and schematics
•	Safe work practices and risk assessment
•	Attention to detail
•	Problem-solving skills
•	Communication and teamwork
Please provide Resume and Qualifications if you are interested. Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.
Lodged 27th July 26 - Closes 24th August 26
